idea-plugin.name: Rider LSP Server
idea-plugin.description: Exposes Rider's C++ intellisense as a TCP-based LSP server. Allows external LSP clients (for example Claude Code through rider-lsp-query.py) to query navigation, completion, hover, diagnostics, and symbol search.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.1.0
  • Fixed memory leak: diagnostics listeners and Rider goto sessions are now released when a client disconnects.
  • Symbol search no longer loads full documents for engine headers.
  • Multiple clients can be connected at once; the 30 second connection cap is gone.
  • Settings changes apply immediately to open projects.
  • No upper Rider version bound.
